examples.english: I thank God that I baptized none of you, except Crispus and Gaius,
Now, therefore, I know no other god besides Him.
examples.source: History of Eustathius and Theopiste part 2

examples.coptic: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲓϧⲉⲗⲗⲟ ⲉⲣϩⲏⲧⲥ ⲛϯ ⲉⲧⲟⲧϥ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲁⲓⲯⲁⲗⲙⲟⲥ ϫⲉⲁⲓϫⲟⲥ ϫⲉϯⲛⲁⲁⲣⲉϩ ⲉⲛⲁⲙⲱⲓⲧ ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛⲧⲁϣⲧⲉⲙⲉⲣⲛⲟⲃⲓ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲁⲗⲁⲥ . ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲧⲁ ⲡⲓϧⲉⲗⲗⲟ ϫⲉϯϩⲟⲩⲓϯ ⲛⲗⲉⲝⲓⲥ ⲛⲁϥ ⲛⲁϥⲧⲁϩⲛⲟ ⲙⲙⲟϥ ⲡⲉ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙⲙⲟⲥ ϫⲉⲡⲁⲓⲱⲧ **ⲉⲃⲏⲗ** ⲛⲧⲁϭⲓⲥⲃⲱ ⲉϯϩⲟⲩⲓϯ ⲛⲗⲉⲝⲓⲥ ϯⲛⲁϭⲓ ⲛϯⲙⲁϩⲥⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲁⲛ .
examples.english: The elder began to teach him this psalm: “I said: I will guard my ways, so that I may not sin with my tongue;” And when the elder had recited the earlier words, he restrained him, saying: “My father, unless I learn the first verse, I will not study the second.”

examples.english: And who is blind, but my servants? and deaf, but they that rule over them? yea, the servants of God have been made blind.

examples.english: and I said, I will inform thee, saying, Buy it before those that sit, and before the elders of my people: if thou wilt redeem it, redeem it, but if thou wilt not redeem it, tell me, and I shall know; for there is no one beside thee to do the office of a kinsman, and I am after thee: and he said, I am here, I will redeem it.
